pages.text: The Reactor is your mid-game $(4)powerhouse$(0): one unit outshines a dozen generators — but it demands you master $(bold)heat control$(0).$(br2)$(bold)Building it:$(0)$(li)Frame a $(4)hollow sealed box$(0) with Reactor Casings (outer edge length 5 or 7)$(li)Place 1 Reactor Core inside$(li)Put the $(l:akaishi:fuel_system)controller$(/l) and ports (Fuel/Energy Output/Waste) into the walls$(li)Add fuel rods (up to 10) and cooling components (up to 20) inside$(br2)The controller only works once the structure is formed. Break any casing and the structure collapses, halting the burn.

$(bold)Firing it up:$(0)$(li)Each fuel rod unlocks one fuel slot — more rods, more fuel cells burned at once$(li)Drop fuel cells into the Fuel Port (27-slot buffer, item-pipe friendly); they are fed into the controller automatically$(li)Empty cells are retrieved on their own$(br2)$(bold)Where the output goes:$(0)power flows out through the Energy Output Port into your grid; $(4)depleted fuel$(0) is pumped into the Waste Port's tank.$(br2)Want longer, stronger burns? Master both fuel and cooling first — see "$(l:akaishi:fuel_system)Fuel & Cooling$(/l)".

$(bold)Temperature is the line between life and boom:$(0)$(li)Base temperature is 300℃; hotter fuel raises it$(li)$(4)400-700℃$(0): the sweet spot, full output$(li)$(e)850℃$(0): warning — output starts to drop (it won't shut down)$(li)$(c)1000℃$(0): the cap! A $(4)10-second countdown to explosion$(0) that leaves a huge decay zone$(br2)$(bold)Cooling it down:$(0)cooling components only work when $(4)adjacent to a fuel rod$(0), and heat sinks make them far stronger; passive cooling alone removes only about 20% of heat — heat sinks do the heavy lifting.$(br2)Even mining blocks at full heat leaks a decay zone — $(bold)always keep an exit plan$(0).

$(bold)Depleted fuel is not junk:$(0)roughly 20% of what you burn becomes it, and it can be $(4)recycled$(0) instead of thrown away.$(br2)That waste tank has a capacity limit — pump it out with fluid pipes on time, or feed it into your purification/recycling chain, or the reactor will stall once it's full. A full tank burns your fuel for nothing.$(br2)Follow the recycling path in "$(l:akaishi:liquid_fuel)Liquid Fuel Chain$(/l)" and "$(l:akaishi:plasma)Plasma Chain$(/l)".

Suggested reading order: start with the "$(l:akaishi:generator)Energy Generator$(/l)" → understand "Fuel & Cooling" → then take on the Reactor → push toward the Fusion Reactor once your power needs outgrow it.
